message.content:
It’s hard to give one single “color” because desserts come in all sorts of hues—think creamy whites, rich browns, pastel pinks, deep reds, bright yellows, even neon greens! If you had a particular treat in mind (like a strawberry shortcake, tiramisu, or chocolate mousse), let me know and I’ll tell you its usual shade. Otherwise here’s a quick rundown:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) |
|---------|------------------|
| Chocolate cake / brownie | Dark brown, almost black |
| Vanilla sponge | Off‑white/cream |
| Strawberry shortcake | Light pink/pale red |
| Lemon meringue pie | Yellow base + fluffy white topping |
| Red velvet cake | Deep crimson/red |
| Tiramisu | Creamy beige/tan |
| Fruit tart | Bright fruit tones (red, orange, green, purple) |

If there’s a specific dessert you’re curious about—or if you were actually thinking of *the* desert instead of dessert—just drop it into your next reply!
